item.title: Iran drone strike halts Qatari LNG, sparks global energy crisis
item.description: Iranian drone attack shuts Qatar LNG exports, sending energy prices soaring across Asia and Europe, raising costs for industries and consumers worldwide.

item.title: Higher capital goods prices lift imported inflation
item.description: U.S. import prices climbed 0.2% in January, led by higher capital goods costs, while fuel prices fell, reflecting mixed inflation trends.

item.title: U.S. jobless claims steady as layoffs plunge in February
item.description: U.S. jobless claims held steady while layoffs plunged in February, signaling a stable labor market as the Fed weighs inflation risks and interest rate policy.

item.title: Iran war may disrupt supply of semiconductor materials
item.description: U.S.-Israel war with Iran may disrupt semiconductor materials like helium and raise energy costs, threatening chip production and AI data center expansion.

item.title: Tech giants pledge to fund power for AI data centers
item.description: Google, Microsoft, Meta and Amazon pledge to fund new electricity generation for AI data centers under a White House deal aimed at preventing higher power bills.

item.title: Fed report shows modest economic growth, prices still rising
item.description: Fed Beige Book shows modest U.S. economic growth, rising prices and stable jobs, while Trump's immigration crackdown disrupts businesses in Minneapolis.

item.title: On the Market: Bloomington office, industrial and Lakeville land
item.description: Bloomington office and industrial properties plus 95 acres of commercial and industrial land in Lakeville highlight new Twin Cities opportunities.

item.title: Lawmakers call for release of Blatnik Bridge replacement funds
item.description: Democratic senators urge U.S. DOT to release $1.05B for replacing the aging Blatnik Bridge, improving safety and trade between Wisconsin and Minnesota.

item.title: Greco proposes 150-unit active-adult project in Woodbury
item.description: Greco Properties plans a 150-unit active-adult apartment and townhome development in Woodbury’s Gold Line station area after a unanimous planning commission vote.

item.title: $119M Minnesota State Patrol HQ planned in Roseville
item.description: Roseville planning officials advance plans for a $119M Minnesota State Patrol headquarters that will consolidate six metro locations into one facility by 2028.
